verdict.rationale: Dover documents a compliant EEO collection flow: an optional survey at the end of the application, recruiters see only aggregate results, and a Diversity (EEO) reporting tab. The evidence never shows recruiters adding custom application questions or setting knockout rules. Interview feedback forms and AI applicant scoring are separate features and don't count here. missing for 10: custom application-form questions, knockout/disqualification rules, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, application forms are mine to shape — custom questions, knockout rules, and EEOC/demographic collection handled compliantly

citations.quote: Applicants see an optional survey at the end of the application. You only see aggregate results, never individual answers.
If you collect the voluntary EEO survey from applicants, the **Diversity (EEO)** tab shows the combined answers for all jobs or for one job, and the number of responses.
